title: Keto Algerian Fish Tagine
description: A flavorful and rich keto fish tagine recipe inspired by Algerian cuisine, featuring a creamy and dreamy sauce.

ingredients.name: Tagine Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: Combine cumin, coriander, cinnamon, turmeric, and paprika

ingredients.name: Algerian Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality, extra-virgin olive oil

instructions: Season the fish with salt and black pepper.
Heat the Algerian Olive Oil in a large, oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the fish to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, until the fish is cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, prepare the creamy sauce by combining the Dreamy Cream, Tagine Spice Mix, and a pinch of salt in a small bowl.
Remove the skillet from the oven and brush the creamy sauce over the fish.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
